downloadIntro.zh: 当前版本 v1.56.20（Windows）。Mac 版暂为 v1.56.0，选择与你的电脑匹配的安装包。
downloadIntro.en: The current release is v1.56.20 for Windows; the Mac build is still v1.56.0. Choose the installer that matches your computer.

summary.zh: 适用于常见的 Intel 与 AMD 电脑，提供标准安装程序。
summary.en: For common Intel and AMD PCs, delivered as a standard installer.

summary.zh: 适用于 Apple 芯片 Mac，以 DMG 磁盘映像安装。
summary.en: For Apple silicon Macs, delivered as a DMG disk image.

highlights.zh: 同品种多窗口画线同步：同一品种开了多个窗口时画线是同一份，在任一窗口画线、拖动、改样式或删除，其他窗口实时跟随，画的过程中就能看到；价格在所有周期完全一致。绘图工具栏新增链条开关，可随时改回各窗口各画各的。
highlights.en: Drawings sync across panes of the same symbol: draw, drag, restyle or delete in any pane and every other pane of that symbol follows live, even mid-stroke, at the same price on every timeframe. A chain toggle in the drawing toolbar switches back to separate drawings per pane.

highlights.zh: 画线支持撤销与恢复：Ctrl+Z 撤销上一步画线操作（新画、删除、拖动、改样式、清除所有标注都能撤销），Ctrl+Y 或 Ctrl+Shift+Z 恢复，Mac 上为 ⌘Z / ⌘⇧Z。
highlights.en: Undo and redo for drawings: Ctrl+Z steps back through new, deleted, moved and restyled drawings, even a full clear; Ctrl+Y or Ctrl+Shift+Z redoes (⌘Z / ⌘⇧Z on Mac).

highlights.zh: 绘图工具栏新增「保持绘图模式」：开启后画完一个图形自动接着用同一工具，按 Esc 结束；射线画到水平、垂直或 45° 时端点旁会提示，按住 Shift 可锁定为水平。
highlights.en: Stay in drawing mode keeps the same tool armed after each shape until Esc; rays show a badge when they lie level, vertical or at 45°, and Shift locks them level.

highlights.zh: 时间跳转可以跳到整个存档的任意时刻（到存档设定的截止时间为止），不再局限于已加载的约二十天；选着画图工具时，鼠标移进哪个窗口，焦点和工具就跟到哪个窗口，第一下点击即开始画。
highlights.en: Jump to any moment in the whole session up to its end time, not just the few weeks already loaded; with a drawing tool picked, moving into another pane brings focus and the tool along, so the first click there draws.

highlights.zh: 修复双击结束折线时顺带放大窗口、多窗口时「回退到光标所在 K 线」与从图表吸取止损止盈价只在第一个窗口有效、选着画图工具切换窗口或周期后工具画不了等问题。
highlights.en: Fixed double-clicking to finish a path also maximizing the pane, rewind-to-cursor and picking stop/target prices off the chart working only in the first pane, and a picked drawing tool not drawing after switching panes or timeframes.
